race.comment: MONACO FLYER (5) has a moderate winning strike-rate but performed well last time at Casino, finishing fourth over 1000m after being in contention on the bend. Likely improver with strong prospects. PERFECT BETH (11) has not appeared since she finished eighth over 1000m at Toowoomba on February 21. Strong chance to kick the campaign off on the right note. SET TO PROPHET (1) had been in top form scoring two wins on end prior to missing the frame last time out at Tamworth. Coming back in journey today. UNDER THE COLLAR (2) can play a more significant role this time.
